provenance.search_result: Latest protocol.c commits in both repositories retain the unguarded shift; inspected 100 cgutman and 97 lsalzman protocol.c commits and GitHub issue searches for shift timeout (zero matches). Fragment-shift fix 7c07702 is unrelated; no existing timeout-shift fix was found.
provenance.original_observation: Native AppleClang UBSan halt-on-error in real T069 silent-loss E2E: protocol.c:1378:21 shift exponent 32 is too large for 32-bit unsigned int; enet_protocol_check_timeouts -> enet_protocol_send_outgoing_commands -> enet_host_service -> sp5_control_transport_step -> input_owner. Independently reproduced by the deterministic timeout unit test at attempt 33.
provenance.rationale: For a 32-bit unsigned threshold, mathematical 2^(attempts-1) always meets timeoutLimit when attempts >32; short-circuit before shifting. Preserve exact defined comparisons for attempts 1..32; zero has no transmitted attempt and uses only the absolute timeout. Keep minimum/maximum deadlines and retransmission scheduling unchanged.
provenance.target_validation: T043 firmware-13.60 ENet smoke used the prior build without this guard. No on-device result for this patch; portable tests are not hardware evidence.
